pca.note: The reversion-significance threshold is not lowered below the incumbent B2 value because prior controlled unit-root diagnostics showed severe false-admission inflation when it was relaxed.

coherence.note: Relation quality is strengthened rather than relaxed because the previous one-token 0.08 gate admitted economically unrelated hedge legs.

guards: retain two-letter polarity/entity tokens and all numeric tokens
require at least two shared salient entity/content tokens
require salient-token Jaccard >=0.65 within an event and >=0.80 across events

required_evidence_before_integration: exact-head public paper smoke with executable books and cost accounting
common-sample incumbent versus challenger candidate-count and fill comparison
PCA/B1/B2 net edge and bundle PnL under 1x, 1.5x and 2x cost stress
semantic relation counterexample tests plus chronological Brier/log-loss and executable PnL
external direct-probability rows with chronological terminal scoring; raw Binance/GDELT features remain research-only until calibrated
strategy-level PnL, drawdown, turnover, capital utilization and cross-strategy covariance
no regression in drawdown, kill switch, concentration or paper-only execution boundaries
interpretation: The current evidence does not establish profitable LF alpha; B1/B2 are raw-positive but not maker-positive and external candidates are negative after costs.
This challenger increases search breadth and lowers only paper executable-edge/warm-up gates while retaining actual fee/slippage/VWAP rechecks.
Statistical and semantic guards known to manufacture false opportunities are not relaxed merely to increase trade count.
External intelligence is now connected to the paper input surface, but it will abstain until a fresh explicit q_external survives mapping and freshness checks.
